title: license_registry
description: Schema for schemas/licenses.json — the single registry of every third-party dataset, its license, attribution string, and usage constraints (Handbook §6.4). CI fails if a pack manifest references an item absent here; the About screen renders attributions from this file.

item.description: Dataset item id, matching pack-manifest contents ids (`kind:name[-version]`).

license.description: SPDX identifier where one exists; otherwise a registry-defined code documented in usage_constraints.

attribution.description: Exact attribution string to render on the About screen.

usage_constraints.description: Constraints beyond the SPDX license text (redistribution limits, no-modification clauses, share-alike scope).

added_at.description: Date the entry was added to the registry.
